selection.rule: validation pitch log loss; within 0.005 nats prefer context LGB then history LGB then GRU; GRU zone/result may degrade at most 0.03 nats vs history LGB
selection.reason: lightgbm_history is the simplest eligible model within 0.005 nats of best validation pitch log loss (1.158778).
selection.resource_gate: Requires independent deployed p95<500ms and RSS<400MiB before promotion.
